prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: inspection-document-closeup
TEACHING PURPOSE: Let viewers inspect the requested artifact and unchanged publication state.
CAMERA: Top-down near-flat document photography, with a human hand at the edge.
A large completely blank ivory inspection sheet on an oak desk, occupying LEFT TWO THIRDS and nearly square to camera. The same engineer's hand rests lightly at bottom left, not writing. A closed dark navy candidate folio occupies far right. Beautiful morning task light, paper fibers and subtle copper clip, no marks or letters anywhere. Keep the paper center clear for exact overlaid report fields. Keep upper-right wall soft and dark for a publication-state comparison. No signatures, approval stamps, celebration or published product.
COMPOSITING INTENT: Report fields are set directly on the paper; a separate dark publication-state margin stays bound to C-17. The missing summary is the focal discovery.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: LOCAL TOY SIMULATION. Open the returned report: two checks pass; one required summary is missing. The engineer now has something to repair. Candidate C seventeen remains unpublished. That is a useful inspection result, not a publication success and not a production security certification.
